metadata.citation_title: Compact K\"ahler surfaces with semipositive anticanonical bundle
metadata.citation_abstract: We classify compact K\"ahler surfaces with semipositive anticanonical bundle. In particular, we resolve a question of Demailly--Peternell--Schneider: any blowup of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at 9 points on a smooth cubic has semipositive anticanonical bundle.

source_corrections_or_scope: Theorem1.1 must retain zero normal degree from its standing subsection setting.
Vertical linearization is distinct from a complete holomorphic tubular neighborhood.

Remark1.4 lists up to nine blowups in the big weak-del-Pezzo case, but nef and big on a rational surface requires K^2>0 and therefore at most eight P2 blowups; that numerical parenthesis is not adopted.
The singular cutoff function is smooth off the divisor; the induced metric is smooth across it after cancelling the logarithmic zero.
